bibliographic.title: Late Night in the Saugus Public Library
bibliographic.author: Eric W. Brown
bibliographic.description:
This was a sample interactive fiction story written to help introduce the concept, generate some interest in the Saugus.net Ghost Story Contest, and use for teaching purposes.

You've fallen asleep in the library and it's closed up around you. You need to clean up after yourself and make a graceful exit to save yourself from embarrassment.

The setting is based on the real Saugus Public Library and the books in it are all real.
